title: LongSafety: Evaluating Long-Context Safety of Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating open-ended model responses to long-context adversarial instructions designed to elicit discriminatory expressions and unfair judgments, using a multi-agent LLM framework to judge the safety of the output.
